scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @interprep/api" "npm run dev -w @interprep/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @interprep/shared && npm run build -w @interprep/retrieval && npm run build -w @interprep/llm && npm run build -w @interprep/pipeline && npm run build -w @interprep/api && npm run build -w @interprep/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @interprep/shared --if-present && npm run test -w @interprep/retrieval --if-present && npm run test -w @interprep/pipeline --if-present
